methodological_notes: The benchmark does not use BPI monetary mismatch arithmetic as a historical REVIEW ground-truth label.
Natural delayed-evidence episodes come directly from the BPI process state at t0.
REVIEW/ABSTAIN-like conditions are introduced through controlled, fully logged interventions.
Transaction exposure remains an independent variable and does not determine the intervention class.
The same source case can appear in multiple experimental arms; benchmark_episode_id uniquely identifies each episode.
